newsitem.title: INDIA: India wheat import contracts at 1.68 mln tonnes.
newsitem.headline: India wheat import contracts at 1.68 mln tonnes.

text.p: India has so far contracted to import 1.68 million tonnes of wheat in fiscal 1996/97 (April-March), Commerce Minister Bolla Buli Ramaiah said on Monday.
The Press Trust of India (PTI) quoted Ramaiah as saying in parliament that most of the wheat was expected to arrive by the end of March.
He said some shipments from Canada might get delayed due to adverse weather conditions there. He did not give details.
In December, the federal government authorised the state-run State Trading Corporation (STC) to import up to two million tonnes of wheat in 1996/97 to augment supplies
Ramaiah said the cost of wheat imports is estimated at 10.43 billion rupees. --New Delhi newsroom +91-11 301 3034
